title: Your Sagittarius Friend Is Always Leaving
topic: Sagittarius zodiac satire: a Sagittarius is always leaving
mechanism: Inside a Sagittarius there is a room where every door says EXIT, a compass with no north, a bow and arrow labelled TRUTH aimed at your bangs, and a calendar marked PLANS that is completely blank, so she books flights mid-sentence and forgets the passport.

beats.hook: Brunch under a big SAGITTARIUS sign: Luna books a flight to Peru mid-brunch, mid-sentence
beats.story: Syrup floods her phone; fun, free and dangerously honest: your bangs were a mistake; suitcase always packed, sleeps in hiking boots; thirty countries, zero dentists
beats.rise: A goodbye party where everyone cries; Luna waves from the gate, never happier
beats.twist: The gate agent holds out her hand: passport, please. Luna turns her bag upside down; the passport is in the freezer next to the peas
beats.mechanism: Inside her head: every door says EXIT, a compass with no north, a bow and arrow TRUTH that pops the balloon next to Bea, a blank PLANS calendar
beats.ending: She takes the night bus home, the party is still going, Maya cheers, Luna eats half the cake, and that night she books a flight to Iceland

seed.what: Luna's phone (it books Peru in the hook and Iceland in the end)
